title: Extraction and Deadline
premise: Felix Underhill, a private security contractor who has spent twelve years protecting clients nobody trusts, receives a meeting invitation from her handler, Mara Voss — sent two days after Mara's confirmed death. Following the invitation, Felix discovers Mara was investigating an attack scheduled to look like an industrial accident at the Meridian Exchange, and that someone inside their own firm rewrote the protocols to make it possible. As Felix races to stop it, she uncovers that her own identity was manufactured as part of the operation, forcing her to decide which version of herself — and which makeshift family of colleagues, liars, and ghosts — she will trust. In the end, Felix exposes the architect of the plot, her former mentor Aldous Crane, sacrifices the fabricated identity he built for her, and walks away with a found family of survivors who know her real name.
about_author: Elodie Amberdale is a former risk analyst who spent a decade writing threat assessments before turning to fiction. She lives in a coastal town where she collects tide tables and writes thrillers about people whose jobs depend on other people's secrets.

chapters.title: The Invitation
chapters.summary: Felix Underhill works a routine protection detail in Rotterdam, all nerves and procedure, when an encrypted meeting request arrives from Mara Voss — her handler, dead forty-eight hours. POV: Felix. Emotional beat: cold dread beneath professional calm; the first crack in the rules she lives by.

chapters.title: Twelve Years of Rewritten Rules
chapters.summary: Flashback-woven chapter: Felix reviews her contract history with the firm, Halcyon Protective Group, noticing how many protocols changed after Mara signed off on them. Her colleague Dev Okafor warns her not to open the attachment. POV: Felix. Emotional beat: loyalty curdling into suspicion.

chapters.title: Dead Handler, Live Meeting
chapters.summary: Felix attends the meeting point anyway — a shuttered ferry terminal — and finds only a burner phone preloaded with Mara's voice notes describing 'the Meridian job' and a warning: don't report this through channels. POV: Felix. Emotional beat: grief weaponized into purpose.

chapters.title: Meridian Exchange
chapters.summary: Felix surveils the Meridian Exchange, a financial hub hosting a high-security summit in nine days, and spots security gaps that match Mara's notes exactly — gaps someone engineered deliberately. POV: Felix. Emotional beat: the sick clarity of seeing a trap being built.

chapters.title: The Client Nobody Trusts
chapters.summary: Halcyon assigns Felix to protect Meridian's paranoid COO, Ines Kovač, placing her inside the very building she suspects. Dev covers her blind side but asks too few questions. POV: Felix. Emotional beat: double life tightening like a wire.

chapters.title: Voice Notes, Part Two
chapters.summary: A second batch of Mara's recordings surfaces, revealing Mara suspected Halcyon's director of operations, Aldous Crane, had rewritten extraction protocols to enable an 'accident.' POV: alternating Felix and Mara (via recordings). Emotional beat: intimacy with the dead; being known by a ghost.

chapters.title: Crane
chapters.summary: Felix meets her mentor Aldous Crane face-to-face for the first time since Mara's death. He is warm, paternal, and asks precisely the wrong questions about her off-hours movements. POV: Felix. Emotional beat: filial love shadowed by the first real fear.

chapters.title: Ines
chapters.summary: An assassination attempt on Ines Kovač during a transit route — staged to look like carjacking — nearly succeeds. Felix saves her, and Ines, sharp and terrified, admits she hired Halcyon because she trusts no one, including them. POV: Felix with an Ines interlude. Emotional beat: two guarded women recognizing each other.

chapters.title: Found Family, Audited
chapters.summary: Felix, Dev, and forensic accountant Priya Raghavan — Mara's old friend — form an off-book team in a safehouse. Priya traces shell companies feeding Meridian's catering and HVAC contracts. POV: rotating among the three. Emotional beat: warmth kindling in a conspiracy; chosen family forming under fire.

chapters.title: The Accident Schedule
chapters.summary: Priya's money trail reveals a date: the summit's closing night, when a gas-system 'failure' would kill dozens and erase evidence of a massive fraud. Five days remain. POV: Priya primary. Emotional beat: horror at how tidy evil looks on a spreadsheet.

chapters.title: Protocol Seven
chapters.summary: Felix discovers Protocol Seven, a rewritten extraction rule that would pull all Halcyon contractors out of Meridian ninety minutes before the attack — including her. She realizes her own standing orders are the murder weapon's trigger. POV: Felix. Emotional beat: betrayal at the level of muscle memory.

chapters.title: Who Wrote Felix Underhill
chapters.summary: Digging into personnel files, Felix finds her employment history contains forged records going back further than her memory reaches — her identity itself may be a Halcyon construct. POV: Felix. Emotional beat: vertigo; the self as a document someone else drafted.

chapters.title: Dev's Choice
chapters.summary: Dev confronts Felix: he knew about the anomalies for weeks and stayed silent to protect her. Their fight fractures the safehouse team just as Halcyon flags their access logs. POV: Dev. Emotional beat: love expressed as anger; forgiveness deferred.

chapters.title: Ines Opens the Books
chapters.summary: Felix risks everything by telling Ines the truth. Instead of firing her, Ines grants covert access to Meridian's building systems — the only way to reach the gas infrastructure. POV: alternating Felix and Ines. Emotional beat: trust as a deliberate act against instinct.

chapters.title: Mara's Last Dead Drop
chapters.summary: Following a clue in the voice notes, Felix retrieves Mara's physical evidence cache — photos implicating Crane directly, and a note: 'He made you. That's how you'll beat him.' Two days left. POV: Felix. Emotional beat: grief transmuted into inheritance.

chapters.title: Burn Notice
chapters.summary: Halcyon activates Protocol Seven early, terminating Felix's contract and branding her a rogue asset. Hunted by her own colleagues, she goes dark with Dev and Priya. POV: Felix. Emotional beat: exile from the only family structure she had.

chapters.title: Ninety Minutes
chapters.summary: Summit closing night. The team infiltrates Meridian through maintenance tunnels while evacuation orders quietly ripple through Halcyon ranks. Felix must disable the gas system manually before the staged failure. POV: Felix, real-time tension. Emotional beat: terror sharpened into focus.

chapters.title: The Architect
chapters.summary: Crane intercepts Felix in the plant room. He confesses — the fraud, the accident, even crafting her identity as his perfect instrument — and offers her a new name, a clean slate, one last rewrite. POV: Felix. Emotional beat: the temptation to be someone else, refused.

chapters.title: Extraction
chapters.summary: Felix triggers the emergency venting, flooding the tunnels instead of the summit floor, and fights her way out as Crane escapes into the chaos above. Dev pulls her out through the loading docks. POV: Felix. Emotional beat: survival without victory; the cost counted.

chapters.title: What the Cameras Caught
chapters.summary: Priya's copied ledgers plus Meridian's own security footage give prosecutors everything: Crane is named, warrants issued, Halcyon's board collapses. Ines testifies, finally trusting someone publicly. POV: Priya. Emotional beat: justice arriving unglamorously, on paper.

chapters.title: Real Name
chapters.summary: At Mara's grave, Felix reads her original birth certificate — recovered from the evidence cache — and says her true name aloud for the first time in twelve years. Dev and Priya stand beside her. POV: Felix. Emotional beat: mourning and self-reclamation braided together.

chapters.title: Deadline Passed
chapters.summary: Weeks later, Felix declines Halcyon's successor firm's recruitment offer and instead opens a small, honest protection consultancy with Dev and Priya. A new client arrives with an impossible story — and Felix smiles, because now she writes her own rules. POV: Felix. Emotional beat: quiet hope; the next story beginning.
